::: notes
The reading for this session is two pages on this site. The first tells the story of SCORE and Multi100 at greater length, with the quotations from the preregistration and a table of the four cases. The second is about the article that reported Multi100: the common scale, the rules of the conversion, what they assume, and the questions to put to any effect size that has been converted for a comparison of this kind. The next session leaves the findings behind and turns to the infrastructure that made all of them checkable: where data come from and on what terms, and where the materials and the plans of a study are kept. Every record that we used in this session sits in one of those places.
:::
